description: DKIM key check — Check a domain's DKIM public keys over DNS. Pass domain= and optional selector= (comma list, from the s= tag of a DKIM-Signature header); without a selector it probes 40 common selectors (Google, Microsoft 365, SendGrid, Mailchimp, Proton, Fastmail, Zoho, HubSpot...). Parses each key: RSA bit length or Ed25519, revoked (empty p=), testing t=y, SHA-1-only h=, multiple records; guesses the sending provider from the selector or CNAME. Verdict OK/WEAK/FIX/NO ACTIVE KEY/NOT FOUND. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: email_dkim_check
